services.name: 1 Hour Freestyle

services.name: Honeymoon Island Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: Guided 1.5-hour jet ski tour from Clearwater exploring intracoastal waterways, with open-ride time near Honeymoon Island and Caladesi State Park.

services.name: 2 Hour Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Embark on a two hour journey you and your family will remember for a lifetime. This excursion includes EVERYTHING that the 90-minute jet ski dolphin tour does but more! On this tour we get up close and personal with many of the surrounding spoiler islands within the intracoastal waterway. Our destination point is Three Rookers Island, just North of Honeymoon Island. Three Rooker Island is a local hot spot for many reasons, one being its crystal-clear waters! You will also have the opportunity to catch a glimpse of dolphins at play. Wind and water permitting, we will take the gulf all the way back to see the front side of Caladesi State Park and Clearwater Beach. Please arrive 45 minutes
